query: WITH due AS ( SELECT tenant_id, id, spend_day, reserved_tokens, cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AS cancel, outcome_code FROM generation_operations WHERE state = 'dispatched' AND lease_until + make_interval(secs => $2) < now() ORDER BY tenant_id, id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE generation_operations AS o SET state = CASE WHEN due.cancel THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'unknown' END, outcome_code = CASE WHEN due.cancel THEN coalesce(due.outcome_code, 'cancel_requested') ELSE 'lease_expired' END, finished_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, reserved_tokens = 0, used_tokens = o.used_tokens + due.reserved_tokens FROM due WHERE (o.tenant_id, o.id) = (due.tenant_id, due.id) RETURNING due.tenant_id, due.spend_day, due.reserved_tokens
